# Week 05 — Ship the Ugly Version

**Live URL:** https://sercanozkan55.github.io/so-backend-data/

I shipped the first complete version of my software portfolio. Home, Work, three individual case studies, About, and Contact are live and reachable through the navigation. The cases use real project material and evidence from CV Analyzer, Siliqon, and VR Teacher.

**How it is built:** It is a static HTML and CSS site generated by a small Node.js build script and hosted for free with GitHub Pages. The shared templates generate all seven pages from one case-study data list. It does not need a backend yet because the portfolio content is static. I can maintain it by editing the case data, running `node build-site.mjs`, and pushing the result.

**One real person's reaction:** [NAME / ROLE] opened the site on [DEVICE]. They understood [WHAT LANDED]. They were confused by [WHAT WAS UNCLEAR]. Their most useful comment was: “[SHORT QUOTE OR PARAPHRASE].” I will change [NEXT ACTION] because of it.

**Still ugly:**

- The case-study writing needs a tighter edit and more measured outcomes.
- Siliqon and VR Teacher are private repositories, so visitors can read their case studies but cannot inspect their source.
- VR Teacher still needs a strong in-headset demo capture and measured usability evidence.
- The portfolio has no custom domain or analytics yet.
- I do not have a real portrait ready, so I used the identity kit instead of a fake image or empty placeholder.
